_method_validity_annotation.scope: This file is PRESERVED verbatim. The following per-direction sequence fields are METHOD_INVALID under a reordering condition (Condition D) and MUST NOT be used as Condition D's formal loss metrics: sequence.missing_count, sequence.capture_ratio, and (as their upstream source) sequence.expected_count when expected_count was derived from the last/first ARRIVED sequence rather than the true max/min sequence.
_method_validity_annotation.reason: These fields are copied from sequence_counter.py, which computes sequence_gap_count by accumulating adjacent forward-jumps (seq > prev+1) without reconciling them when the skipped sequence later arrives out of order, and computes expected_count = last_arrived - first_arrived + 1 using the first ARRIVAL as the minimum. Under jitter-induced reordering both are wrong: a lossless-but-reordered stream reports large bogus missing_count (here 189/192, true value 0/0), and when the first arrival is not the minimum sequence, capture_ratio can exceed 1 (here epuck2_to_epuck1 = 1.0023310023310024, mathematically impossible).
_method_validity_annotation.corrected_source_of_truth: experiments/05_objective5_impairment_matrix/objective5_impairment_matrix_v1_condition_D_trial01_attempt01_analysis/reordering_delivery_audit.json (reorder_safe_delivery_analyzer.py v1, set-based). Corrected values: BOTH directions actual_missing_count=0, forwarded_to_bag_capture_ratio=1.0, relay dropped_count=0, duplicate_count=0; out_of_order genuinely > 0 (reordering present, not loss).
_method_validity_annotation.fields_still_valid_in_this_file: latency (mean/median/p95/p99/max message_age_s, VALID_AT_SIM_CLOCK_RESOLUTION), throughput, relay.received_count/forwarded_count/dropped_count, queue_drain, realtime_factor, task_outcome_inputs -- none of these depend on the broken adjacent-delta missing/expected accounting.

latency.clock_domain_evidence: state_publisher, network_impairment_relay, and sequence_counter are all launched with use_sim_time=true and read the same /clock topic; message_age_s = consumer_callback_ros_time (sequence_counter's own get_clock().now() at message receipt) - EpuckState.stamp (state_publisher's get_clock().now() at publish time). Never the rosbag recorder's wall-clock time.
